body.statement: For every finite acquired collection \(E_0\) on which the full correctly typed unconditional procedure \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}(G,Q,\mathcal R(E_0))\) accepts, there exists a branch-indexed switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) using only protocol--slice--source triples represented in \(E_0\), such that \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\), \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\leq \operatorname{Cost}(E_0)\), and \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\) has at most \(M=|\Omega|=\sum_{j=1}^{k}|\Omega_j|\) nonempty records and at most \(M\) distinct protocols.  Each branch \((j,\omega)\in\Omega\) has exactly one owner, and that owner supplies one positive, measured-ancestry protocol--slice--source triple and a finite ancestor--district transcript that succeeds for the concrete branch \(\omega\).  Conversely, every switching certificate accepted by \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) induces a complete accepting \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run on \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\).  No exchange of \(\forall\omega\exists\) with \(\exists\forall\) is asserted.
body.justification: This switching normal form is the load-bearing bridge from complete fixed-source identification to finite priced acquisition without changing the order of the branch and source quantifiers.
body.gap: Published completeness gives \(\forall(j,\omega)\exists\) a successful source; it does not give one source satisfying \(\exists\forall\) for an entire factor.
body.consumer: The optimizer may search one auditable source record per concrete target branch and charge repeated protocols only once.
body.proof_tex:
Write \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\) for an element of the finite disjoint union \(\Omega\), and write
\[
 \mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1
\]
when \(S\in\Pi\), the event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\) has positive mass in the support table returned by \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\), \(T\) is a measured-ancestry single-district factor extracted from \(\operatorname{Slice}(S,\ell)\), and \(\tau\) is a valid successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) restriction transcript for the concrete instantiation \(\omega\) of \(C_j\).  All four clauses are well typed by Definitions \(\mathrm{Legal\ protocol\ class}\), \(\mathrm{Measured\ source\ slice}\), and \(\mathrm{Restriction\ transcript}\); positivity and measured ancestry use Assumptions \(\mathrm{Positive\ source\ law}\) and \(\mathrm{Measured\ ancestry}\).

Assume first that the full correctly typed run on \(\mathcal R(E_0)\) accepts.  The target-factorization definition partitions the transformed ancestry into \(C_1,\ldots,C_k\), and the finite branch definition enumerates every assignment and induced equality type in \(\Omega_j\).  Acceptance of the complete exhaustive source search therefore implies, for every concrete branch,
\[
 \forall\alpha\in\Omega\quad
 \exists (S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha},\tau_{\alpha})
 \text{ represented in }E_0:
 \mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}(S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha},\tau_{\alpha})=1.       \tag{1}
\]
Indeed, if (1) failed for some \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\), the complete factor loop would exhaust every decoded source for that concrete branch and return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), contrary to the premise.  This step uses the completeness/exhaustive-search clause of the stipulated full \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) run; it makes no uniformity assertion.

Because \(\Omega\) and the source collection are finite, choose the lexicographically first witness in (1) for each \(\alpha\).  For a chosen successful call, Proposition \(\mathrm{Fixed\ factor\ obstruction}\) gives \(\mathfrak O(T_{\alpha},C_j)=\varnothing\); otherwise that proposition would make the call fail.  Lemma \(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\) then permits replacement of \(\tau_{\alpha}\) by its canonical finite transcript without changing success.

Create one nonempty switching record for each distinct chosen triple \((S_{\alpha},\ell_{\alpha},T_{\alpha})\), let it own exactly the branches choosing that triple, and attach the corresponding concrete transcript \(\tau_{\alpha}\) to every owned branch.  The ownership sets are disjoint and have union \(\Omega\), because each \(\alpha\) was assigned exactly once.  There are at most \(|\Omega|=M\) nonempty records, and hence at most \(M\) distinct protocols.  Every retained protocol--slice--source triple occurs in \(E_0\), so
\[
 \operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\subseteq \operatorname{Prot}(E_0).          \tag{2}
\]
By the distinct-protocol cost definition and \(c(a)\geq0\) from Assumption \(\mathrm{Binary\ rational\ cost}\), (2) gives
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})
 =\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_{\mathrm{sw}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
 \leq
 \sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(E_0)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a)
 =\operatorname{Cost}(E_0).                                                       \tag{3}
\]
Every parsing, legality, support, source-typing, branch-partition, and transcript clause in Definition \(\mathrm{Switching\ operational\ acceptance}\) now holds.  Moreover, for every \(\alpha\), the complete run encounters its retained successful source.  It therefore does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\), and \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\).

Conversely, suppose \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1\).  Its ownership masks partition \(\Omega\).  Hence for every \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\) there is one decoded record satisfying \(\mathsf{Succ}_{\alpha}=1\).  Its triple is retained in \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\), so the exhaustive source search for \(\alpha\) succeeds.  This holds for every branch of every factor, and the complete unconditional run therefore accepts.  Notice that the proved quantifiers are exactly
\[
 \forall (j,\omega)\in\Omega\;\exists(S,\ell,T,\tau)\;\mathsf{Succ}_{(j,\omega)}(S,\ell,T,\tau)=1,
\]
which is all the switching construction uses.
